opportunities.description:
Please read before applying ?

Hey! I’m looking for a model to join me for a relaxed street photography shoot in London. All experience levels are welcome!

If you’ve already applied to my previous listing, you don’t need to apply again. That listing expired, but I still have your application.

Most of my photography work has taken place in Paris, so I’m using these shoots to explore locations in London and get comfortable with my new Fujifilm setup. I’ll also have my Sony with me, so we can try a mix of looks.

The plan is to wander around a few streets and capture natural, casual portraits with a street style feel. I’m thinking East London, as it tends to be quieter during the week, but I’m happy to hear your location suggestions and creative ideas. If you need some headshots, we can work those in too.

This is an unpaid collaboration, and you’ll receive photos from the shoot to use for your portfolio and social media. The whole shoot will take place outdoors or in public spaces.

Please note that I fit these shoots around work, and they always take place during the daytime. We can agree on a date and location that work for us both.

If you’re interested, drop me a message! Feel free to send over any ideas or inspiration from Pinterest, Instagram or wherever you’ve spotted something you’d like to try.

If your application is approved, please keep an eye on your messages. I’ll send you my availability so we can arrange a shoot.

Thanks!

opportunities.description:
I’m looking for male models (18+) for Behind the Mo, a Movember-themed portrait series exploring men’s health, mental wellbeing and the faces we show the world.

This cause matters to me. Before picking up the camera, I completed the Movember activity challenge, logging over 39 hours across 31 workouts and finishing in the top 5% of more than 26,000 participants.

The concept

Each model is photographed in a single portrait inspired by classic menswear (white shirts, ties, braces, blazers and bow ties) with a moustache. The styling is playful, but the expression is honest. Behind every moustache is a real person, and each portrait asks how well we really know how someone is doing.

Who I’m looking for

  • Men aged 18+ with a moustache, or growing one this November
  • Any moustache length welcome, from a few weeks’ growth to a full handlebar
  • All looks, ages and experience levels

Optional story

Models are invited, but never required, to share a short story about a challenge they’ve faced and how they got through it. This is discussed privately at consultation, you approve your words before anything is published, and you choose whether to be named or anonymous.

Details

  • Basis: collaboration (TFP), with edited images for your portfolio
  • Dates: late November to give moustaches time to grow
  • Wardrobe: white shirt, tie, braces, blazer or bow tie if you have them; styling support provided
  • Usage: the conceptual page of my website, social media and portfolio
